title: Chris W FDE 4415 NDE 4415
content: I'm not sure if time slowed down, or that my thoughts and cognitive processes were so incredibly fast. As I fell toward the ground in the space of what might have been two minutes, it is as though my whole life was compressed and replayed in the blink of any eye. I remember two or three distinct images of the whole experience and the rest was just a blur. It was as if my mind was operating in two spaces, in one part, I was trying to control the helicopter, and in the other, I was having the playback experience. In the logical part of my mind I had come to the realization that if the wind shear situation did not abate, I would crash and be killed. In a distant and disembodied way, I was wondering if it would be painful. During the event, I was not afraid. It was only afterward that I felt fear and relief.

elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: During the first few seconds when I realized that the aircraft was out of control and I had the life playback experience.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Altered time, time slowed down.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I had an aviation headset on so I was only hearing what was said through a microphone.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I was calm and somehow dissociated but still focused on flying the helicopter.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control It was far too fast for me to grasp I just knew that it was happening. I had the image of a previously traumatic event pause for a moment in time.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Two parts, one was that my life played back incredibly fast, and two that time seemed to slow down to a crawl.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real It is simply an event. It is most definitely real but I don't know why such an event should happen just before what I conceived to be an imminent death.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Uncertain After this event I felt as though I had been given a clean slate in life and I was freed to move on to my next phase of life.
